build_ParakeetProjection: build a ParakeetProjection module that projects sound hidden states to LLM hidden size using a two-layer MLP with RMSNorm and ReLU2 activation
build_ProjecteParakeet: build a ProjectedParakeet audio encoder that combines a HuggingFace ParakeetEncoder with a projection layer to encode audio features into LLM embeddings
load_weights_ProjecteParakeet: load weights into a ProjectedParakeet model by mapping sound_encoder and sound_projection prefixed keys to internal parameter names
build_ParakeetExtractor: build a ParakeetExtractor that splits raw audio into fixed-duration clips and computes the expected token count for each audio input
compute_audio_token_count: compute the number of audio tokens for a given audio length using the ParakeetExtractor subsampling and clip size logic
